html:
The last phase of the war between Chad and Libya in 1987, in which Chadian forces in Toyota pickup trucks armed with anti-tank missiles routed the much larger Libyan army in northern Chad.

Under Hissene Habre and with French and US support, Chadian troops took Fada and the airbase of Ouadi Doum and raided into Libya itself. Libya lost thousands of men and much equipment. Gaddafi agreed to a ceasefire, and in 1994 the International Court of Justice gave the disputed Aouzou Strip to Chad. The fast pickup with a mounted gun became the model for wars across Africa and beyond. See also Toyota.
sum: The last phase of the war between Chad and Libya in 1987, in which Chadian forces in Toyota pickup trucks armed with anti-tank missiles routed the much larger Libyan army in northern Chad.
